scope: Ten reference family-14 cases; four worked threshold assessments and eight numerical reference records. Not an adviser test, independent evaluation result, full scenario completion certification, or complete policy-rule inventory.
review_basis: Independently read preserved original PDF text on physical pages 2, 3, 4 and 6; navigation register used only to locate source scope. No benchmark evaluation data accessed. Numerical derivations use explicit arithmetic and conservation identities, not evaluation of authored expression strings or adviser calculator code.

source_findings.finding: Silver operative grant uses deductible per hospitalization; Gold operative grant uses defined limit. Defined Limit means admissible hospitalization expenses under selected schedule terms.

Gold note 3 accumulates admissible hospitalization expenses during the policy period; liability starts only above the defined limit. Notes 4 and 5 exclude pre/post expenses from that accumulator and prevent year-to-year carry-over. Note 7 states the sum insured floats among insured members.

Multiple Policies condition V.4 requires settlement under applicable terms and limits indemnification to treatment costs. V.2G requires Gold hospitalization intimation, including episodes with no claim.
